“By totally destroying them” is rendered “destroying them completely,” and “delivered” as “spared.”
“People of Eden” is rendered “sons of Eden.”
“The king of Lair Sepharvaim” is rendered “the king of the city of Sepharvaim.”
“Letters” is rendered “letter,” matching the singular “spread it.”
“Sits the cherubim” is rendered “are enthroned above the cherubim.”

Close to the Hebrew.
“Taunted” is rendered “reproached,” and “lifted up height your eyes” as “haughtily lifted up your eyes.”
The written Hebrew reads “with the abundance” (reading tradition “with my many”); NASB has “my many chariots.” “Pines” is rendered “cypresses,” and “its farthest lodging place” is kept.
NASB supplies “wells,” and renders “canals” as “rivers.”
NASB adds “That you should,” and renders “to make desolate heaps ruined cities” as “turn fortified cities into ruinous heaps.”
“Short of hand” is rendered “short of strength,” and “scorching before standing grain” as “is scorched before it is grown up.”
NASB adds “in” and “But.”
“Arrogance” is rendered “arrogance … to My ears,” and NASB adds “Therefore.”
“Self-sown grain” is rendered “what grows of itself,” and “self-seeded plants” as “what springs from the same.”
“It will add” is rendered “shall again take root.”
